transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’m here because my eating has gotten a bit out of hand, especially on late work nights. I’ll order what I tell myself is just dinner, and then it ends up being an entrée, sides, dessert… and then more snacks from my kitchen. It’s more than I’d eat if someone was sitting there with me.
Do you feel guilty after these late-night eating episodes?
I… I don’t really know how to answer that. I don’t always sit there and name it as guilt. It’s more just… not a great feeling afterward.
Do you feel like you have control over what you eat during those late-night episodes?

Yeah… I think so. Or, I mean, I don’t feel in control. There’s usually a point where I’m still ordering more or opening something else, and I’m thinking I should stop, but it kind of feels like that decision already got away from me.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like within an hour or two?

Yeah… I mean, that’s kind of what happens. On those late work nights I’ll order dinner, but then it becomes an entrée, sides, dessert, and then I end up eating snacks from the kitchen too. It’s… definitely more than I’d eat if someone were there.
Do you ever try to make up for overeating by doing something to counteract the calories?
Um… I’m not sure. What do you mean by counteract? Like… I don’t really know. I don’t think I have a specific thing I do.
Do you ever try to make yourself vomit after one of these eating episodes?
No… I don’t do that. I’ve thought about it in a vague way maybe, but I don’t make myself throw up.
Do you feel like your eating habits are interfering with your daily life or causing you a lot of distress?
I… don’t know. I mean, it bothers me, yeah. I try not to think about it too much, but it’s not like it feels great afterward. Daily life… I’m not sure how to measure that.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating once you've started during those late-night episodes?

Yeah… I think so. Once I start, there’s usually a point where I know I should stop, but I just… keep going back for more. Like opening something else or clicking back to order food, even though I don’t really feel like I’m deciding anymore.
How often do these late-night eating episodes happen?
Um… I guess when I actually look back at delivery receipts and my calendar, it’s usually at least once a week. Sometimes more. It’s been like that for… several months, I think.
How much distress do you feel about your eating habits?
I don’t really know how to put a number on it. It’s… upsetting, I guess. I feel pretty bad about it afterward, but I try not to sit with that too long.
Have you been avoiding social situations because of your eating habits?

Kind of… I mean, I still go out sometimes. But if I’m with coworkers or friends, I’m really careful to just eat a normal amount, or even light. The worse stuff is when I’m alone, usually really late. I’ll close the blinds and… get rid of the delivery bags pretty quickly. I’d be really embarrassed if anyone saw how much it was.
Do you usually eat this way when you're stressed or anxious?
I’m not sure. I mean… sometimes, maybe. But I haven’t really tracked it like that. It’s more that it just kind of happens, especially when I’m by myself.
Do you think your eating late at night is usually triggered by feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?
I don’t know. I guess it could be sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed a clear pattern. It just feels more like… it happens late, when I’m alone.
Do you think your late-night eating episodes are usually triggered by feeling bored?
I don’t really know. Maybe sometimes, if I’m just sitting around, but I haven’t noticed boredom being the main thing. It’s hard to say.
Do you usually feel emotional, like stressed, anxious, or upset, right before these late-night eating episodes happen?
I’m not really sure. I don’t always notice what I’m feeling right before… it’s not like I can clearly say I’m stressed or upset every time. Sometimes I just end up doing it.
Do you think your late-night eating episodes are usually triggered by feeling emotional?
I’m not sure. I mean, maybe sometimes, but I don’t really notice it as an emotional thing most of the time. It just kind of happens.
Do you think your eating episodes are usually triggered by how you're feeling at the moment?
I don’t know… I haven’t really connected it to how I’m feeling in the moment. Sometimes I only realize after that I did it, but I’m not sure what set it off.
Do you usually feel hungry right before these late-night eating episodes happen?

Not usually, no. A lot of times I’ve already had dinner… like a normal dinner. I’ll still end up going into the kitchen, or ordering something, especially if I’m working late on a project. It doesn’t really feel like actual hunger.
Do you feel like you're eating because you're hungry during these late-night episodes?
Not really. A lot of the time I’ve already eaten dinner, so it’s not like I’m physically hungry. I just… end up in the kitchen anyway, or ordering something if I’m up late working.
